```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("qa_translation.R")
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("This is the evaluation you are translating. It is a **fictitious programme**, written for\n")
cat("teaching. The numbers are invented.\n\n")

cat(sprintf("**Programme.** %s \u2014 %s.\n\n", transl_programme$name, transl_programme$what))
cat(sprintf("**Where and when.** %s, %s.\n\n", transl_programme$where, transl_programme$when))
cat(sprintf("**The decision rule.** %s\n\n", transl_programme$rule))

cat("The evaluation was randomised and is methodologically sound. Read the six findings below,\n")
cat("then turn to the brief template. Do not start writing until you have read all six: the\n")
cat("decision depends on how they sit together, not on any one of them.\n\n")

cat("# The findings\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(transl_findings))) {
  f <- transl_findings[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("## Finding %d. %s\n\n", i, f$finding))
  cat(sprintf("%s\n\n", f$numbers))
  cat(sprintf("*What it can bear.* %s\n\n", f$bears))
}

cat("\\newpage\n\n")
cat("# What each finding does not license\n\n")
cat("A brief is judged as much by what it refuses to claim as by what it claims. These are the\n")
cat("claims each finding invites and cannot support.\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(transl_findings))) {
  cat(sprintf("- **Finding %d** (%s) does not license: %s\n",
              i, transl_findings$finding[i], transl_findings$does_not_license[i]))
}
cat("\n")
cat("# The threshold\n\n")
cat(sprintf("The commissioning authority will decide on one number: **%s**. The evaluation's\n", "900 AED per vehicle per year"))
cat("headline estimate is 743 AED, with an upper confidence bound of 796 AED.\n\n")
cat("Nothing in the six findings is hidden or ambiguous. The difficulty of this exercise is\n")
cat("deciding what the evidence supports, not working out what the evidence says.\n")
```
